issues.description: Command names use inconsistent singular/plural form vs existing commands
issues.detail: Existing commands are `quickmark-save`, `quickmark-add`, `quickmark-load`, `bookmark-add`, `bookmark-load` (singular). The new commands are `quickmarks-reload` and `bookmarks-reload` (plural). This breaks the naming convention and command discoverability via tab completion. Consider `quickmark-reload` / `bookmark-reload` for consistency.

issues.description: reload() does not re-init the savemanager/LineParser file handle if path changed
issues.detail: `reload()` calls `_init_lineparser()` which reconstructs the LineParser, but the savemanager was registered against the previous instance in `__init__`. If saves are triggered after reload, the savemanager may operate against a stale lineparser reference, potentially overwriting external changes that were just reloaded.

issues.description: No error handling for missing/corrupt file during reload
issues.detail: If the user edits the file externally and introduces a malformed line, `_parse_line` may raise InvalidUrlError, leaving marks partially cleared (since `self.marks.clear()` already ran). The user gets an exception instead of a graceful error message, and quickmarks state is destroyed. Wrap in try/except and restore prior state on failure.

issues.description: Missing changelog/doc entry for new user-facing commands
issues.detail: Two new commands are added but doc/changelog.asciidoc and doc/help/commands.asciidoc are not updated in this diff. qutebrowser's convention requires command docs to be regenerated and the changelog updated; without these, users won't discover the feature and CI doc-checks may fail.

issues.description: Feature file scenarios are missing names
issues.detail: The two new scenarios in tests/end2end/features/urlmarks.feature use `Scenario:` with no title. Existing scenarios all have descriptive names (e.g. "Saving a bookmark"). Add names like "Reloading bookmarks" / "Reloading quickmarks" for readability and test report clarity.

issues.description: Test does not cover quickmarks reload path or removal-on-reload behavior
issues.detail: `test_reload` only exercises BookmarkManager and only tests replacement of one entry. It doesn't verify that entries removed from the file on disk are dropped from `marks`, nor does it cover QuickmarkManager. Given `clear()` is now called inside reload, an explicit removal test would lock in the intended semantics.

review.summary: The PR cleanly extracts file-loading into a reusable `reload()` method and exposes it via two new commands. Main concerns: command naming (`quickmarks-reload`/`bookmarks-reload`) is inconsistent with existing singular-form commands like `quickmark-save`/`bookmark-add`, no error handling around parse failures during reload (which now also wipes prior state via `clear()`), and missing changelog/docs updates. Tests are thin — feature scenarios lack names, and only one bookmark replacement case is covered.
